title: Abandoned Mine

sections.text: ALTHOUGH THE CONTENT ARE MOSTLY REMOVED. THE LOCATION STILL EXISTS TO THIS DAY AND SERVES A NEW PURPOSE
New Purpose - A gate to get back in time

body:
ALTHOUGH THE CONTENT ARE MOSTLY REMOVED. THE LOCATION STILL EXISTS TO THIS DAY AND SERVES A NEW PURPOSE

New Purpose - A gate to get back in time

Located by the right side beach of the main island map, near the way to Fairway Island on the right side, the cave still exists.

However, the bunker has opened.

A gate opened with green color, teleports player into another place out of the game, when the game has only 2 islands. Return back in time.

The retro Oaklands

Description

You will be basically back in time to the old island where landscapes are mostly flat and drivable easily back then.

Only the map revert is the significance change. But the map is slightly changes from that old time: Exists a portal with green whirl to teleports you back to main game. Only the sea of Finlay Island is saved, other waters are removed. The map takes the version when the Lighthouse are destroyed and Magma Tree no longer spawns on land (need verify on if Magma Tree still exists in that version)

Only you is the only player in that server, no one else joins. Progress are saved like normal.

Profits

  • Mushroom Cave aka Uncertainty Cave will gets easier to reach since there are literal maps point exactly to its location
  • Mysterious Mushroom are easier (?) to get since the cave back then has short roof, making the mushrooms closer to ground
  • Since the sea are not 100% filled like back then (only the main island has proper water), you can easily gather Kelp just like a normal tree on the ground at second island
  • The classic shop are easier to reach back then (at the back of main island), allowing you to buy classic items easily
  • Quests are not tested, need more people performs it in this specific version.

Disadvantages

  • Base that has basement will be half-flooded, making difficulties into basement.
  • Minimaps are not loaded, making players has to use self-intuition to figure the paths (except old players who didn't have maps back then but still remember the way)
  • Selling still works but by individual patches (if using Oak Depot's selling pit or Radical Shack's selling pit), because there was no united Resource Hub back then.
  • Shops are also return to old times, meaning some items are not available to buy

Removed
The following content has been removed from the game or does not exist.

Description

The Abandoned Mine is a Mine located near the Bridge for the Ferwater Island. This location is the starting point for the Key and Uncertain Pickaxe quests.

Appearance

Abandoned mine is a small room located inside of a cliff. Inside there are 3 pillars holding it from collapsing, as well as a blocked off trapdoor that as of date does not lead anywhere. Walls are decorated with unknown neon ores. To the left of the entrance a button is located with runes above it which can be translated to "TRIGGER". UI of the button itself states "Registry", while the interaction prompt states "PRESS TRIGGER". Pressing it activates the Key pedestals.

Trivia

  • For only a single patch, the trapdoor had a sign which read "Laboratory". Coincidentally, next update added the Key quest.
